text: Open issues row is clipped at the right edge of a 640x360 window: 'storage  flaky test  95%  -30%/min  fa...' - last column cut off

Found the issue module only after switching to V camera: a floating purple 'storage' label marks it. In first-person the label is off to the side; finding the sick module took several minutes of circling. Patch with E 4s worked: 89% -> healthy 100%.

Looking back from the 0.2 terrace: the town below and contributor Noor (blue figure) walking up. HUD says 'Noor is helping: on the way up, 1:44 left' - her 2:30 helping timer has been counting down the whole walk, ~45s of her time spent not helping yet.

After stopping on the 0.3 terrace Noor patched (health 93%->96%) and then the HUD says 'Noor is helping: nothing they can reach, 0:52 left'. Good feedback; she seems only to reach modules near the ground.
When Noor's time ran out: 'Noor moved on. Nobody else knew how core worked.' and core immediately got 'dependency drift' (-36%/min). Strong, readable bus-factor moment - good design.

At 0.5 with a contributor line plus stamina in the HUD, the OPEN ISSUES list is replaced entirely by '... and 4 more lines' - no issue is shown at all, so the player cannot see what is sick. Expected at least the worst issue to be listed.

Still at 0.5, after the stamina bar hid: 'OPEN ISSUES 3' then '... and 3 more lines' with zero issue rows. With a contributor line in the HUD the issue list has no room at 640x360; the player sees the count but not which modules.

Billing went down ('billing is down. Users are leaving', OUTAGE in red, users 400->395, weight bar jumped to 7/10). Held Shift+W into the boulder from below for 16 s and it did not move at all (33 m before and after); no message explains why (too heavy? off-centre?).

Tab history during the first climb shows one 'now 0.x' row (min 5, modules 12, users 341, patched 4, down 1, helpers 2) and 'No climb has finished yet'. Readable, but with no finished climb there is nothing to compare; column 'min' is unexplained (minutes?).

Second contributor Lena: HUD 'Lena is helping: on the way up, 0:37 left' - she has spent ~2 of her 2.5 minutes walking up from town and is only now arriving (blue figure on the path). Same as Noor: the helping timer runs during the walk, so most of the help is spent travelling.
